selector.rationale: The presence of scaly, crusted pink plaques and vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy on biopsy are most consistent with cutaneous lupus erythematosus, which is a specific subtype of lupus erythematosus.

rejected.label: Graft-versus-host disease
rejected.why: Lack of explicit evidence for graft-versus-host disease, such as history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation

rejected.label: Drug-induced lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While the patient has been on medications that can induce lupus-like symptoms, the specific findings are more consistent with cutaneous lupus erythematosus

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
rejected.why: The biopsy findings and clinical presentation do not align with paraneoplastic pemphigus, which typically involves autoantibodies against plakins and other proteins
